description:

description:

description:

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E09 — Sheep Doggy!
Molly and Gil meet Farmer Joe and all the cool barnyard animals on his farm; when Farmer Joe's cute baby lamb wanders off during a big swirling popcorn storm, Bubble Puppy has to become a sheepdog and herd her back to safety!

description:

description:

When supervillain Lady Goo Goo starts changing everyone into babies, it's up to Guppy Girl and Bubble Boy to stop her before they get turned into babies too!

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.

description:

Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip; the Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.

description:

description:

description:

After the crew builds a special lemonade stand for Lucas and Lily, a sour Speed Meister sends it rolling through Builder Cove; Rubble & Crew build a bridge to help Crunchy the beaver cross the road.

description:

Park Ranger Rose and the crew discover a meteorite outside of Builder Cove; when Speed Meister and Mega Meister try to take it, the pups need their construction vehicles to save the town and get the meteorite to the Science Centre.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:

Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

description:

When Mayor Humdinger runs for mayor of Adventure Bay, his Mayor Mobile runs out of control; when Ryder and the pups visit Tracker and Carlos in the jungle, a group of monkeys finds itself in sticky bubble trouble.

description:

description:

description:

When Daring Danny sinks the PAW Patroller, the pups must find a way to raise their rig; the pups team up with Alex's mini patrol to retrieve mysteriously missing items.

description:

When bandit Ladybird shrieks havoc in Adventure Bay and takes all the town's treasures, the Mighty Pups team up with new super pals, the Mighty Twins, to save the day -- and Mayor Goodway.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E10 — The Crew Builds a Pig Barn; The Crew Builds a Giant Runway
A new farmer in town asks Rubble & Crew to build a barn for her pig in time for the big Pig Party; Motor's super special birthday present gets delayed, and the pups realize Builder Cove's airport needs a bigger runway.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S03 E02 — The Crew Builds a Sea Wall
Park Ranger Rose asks Rubble and crew to fix the bridge to Bear Island; but when Speed Meister intervenes, the pups must clean up his mess and protect the bears from a rapidly approaching storm with help from Auntie Crane's new Bark Yard Zoomer!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E24 — Pups Save a Jukebox; Pups Save a Mayor on a Wire
Mayor Humdinger steals a jukebox so he can play an annoying song all day long, but Chase and Rubble track it down to save the records; a hungry eagle causes Mayor Goodway's tightrope walking lesson to go awry, sending her down Jake's Mountain.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E01 — Pups Save the Kitty Rescue Crew; Pups Save an Ostrich
Mayor Humdinger creates fake emergencies for his kitties so they can appear better than the PAW Patrol; the Wingnuts get a new pet ostrich, but it gets lost on the trip home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E02 — Pups Meet the Cat Pack
When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help with stopping the creature.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E15 — Pups Save a Friend; Pups Save a Stowaway
When Marshall begins to feel like his clumsy ways are ruining his friends' fun, he decides to take a break from the PAW Patrol and goes off to the woods; Cali becomes an unsuspecting stowaway when she is accidentally packed up into the Paw Patroller.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E25 — Pups Take in a Runaway Kitty!; Pups Save the Cheese Goat!
When Rocky Kitty runs away and tries to join the "PAW Patrol," he helps the pups rescue Humdinger and the kitties from a hang-glider ride; when the Good Neighbor Robots confuse Farmer Al's request, they wind up being the target of a hungry eagle.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

When the Kitty Catastrophe crew gets superpowers, the little kittens cause big problems all over town.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

description:

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

Gil and Bubble Puppy are competing in the Winter Sports Chompetition, a competition for athletes and their dogs; they hope to stop reigning champs Coldsnap and his dog Mr. Husky from cheating to win the gold.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E19 — Fogzilla!
It's lighthouse keeper Deema's birthday, but when a monster named Fogzilla keeps blowing out her lighthouse, she needs to figure out how to get Capt. Molly's ship, carrying her birthday cake to shore, or there won't be a party.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Guppies march with all different kinds of bugs in the Big Bug Parade.
